theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Despite leading the rotation (score 2.365, rank 1, eligible), the headline theme is structurally weak right now: breadth is 0.0 (no internal participation), r10 is negative (-0.138), and the detector's val_state is 'diverging' — price momentum high while participation and recent return have rolled over. This is not a fade/short per guardrails, but a clear reason to stand aside rather than chase the leader. The one validated edge (absolute-trend drawdown control) says do not add to a diverging leader.
theses.dissent: The memory/HBM upcycle may be real and the negative r10 just a shake-out; a leader can re-expand breadth quickly and SMH is the proxy for both memory AND semi cap-equipment flows.

falsifier.text: SMH beats SPY by more than 5% while Memory/HBM breadth rises above 0.4 before the 20-day check-by.
